sections.heading: Physical description
Personality
sections.body:
Patient to a fault, and orderly in a way that unsettles people who notice it. He asks questions as if each answer will be written down, because it will be.

He does not like to be wrong, and he is wrong often. The world moved on without him; he is trying to catch up without saying so.
